newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - December 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - December 16.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Monday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Secret witness says he saw murder suspect Chang Chung-teh enter house of Taoyuan county magistrate on day magistrate and seven others were killed.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Seven more industries to be incorporated under Labour Law in 1997.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Foreign ownership ratio in Taiwan pager operations triggers debate.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Major investment projects cause extra emission of carbon dioxide.
Taiwan speeds liberalisation under pressure from World Trade Organision, Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation forum.
LIBERTY TIMES - Taiwan police bust international drug ring operating in China, Taiwan and Hong Kong.
Russia establishes representative office in Taiwan.
